tools.name: sirfus_request_status
tools.description: Check a request made with sirfus_request_pro: searching, offered to pros, or answered with the one business that has the job. Needs the ticketId and ticketToken that sirfus_request_pro returned.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sirfus_request_pro, sirfus_search · Private data: sirfus_search · Public sink: sirfus_request_pro, sirfus_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sirfus_request_pro, sirfus_search · Private data: sirfus_search · Public sink: sirfus_request_pro, sirfus_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "sirfus_request_pro" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
